Full Stack Engineer - React and Node.js

Own features end to end for a retail commerce platform.

Responsibilities:
- Build React front ends for the storefront
- Develop Node.js services behind those screens
- Design MongoDB collections for the catalogue
- Ship features through the whole stack

Requirements:

- 4+ years of strong Node.js experience, must have
